evals.name: frontend-implementation
evals.prompt: Build a responsive authenticated dashboard with loading, empty, blocked, failure, and recovery states using the existing repository design system.
expected_behavior: Inspects repository conventions before choosing components
Creates an implementation slice plan with a testable DoD
Covers responsive, keyboard, accessibility, and failure states
forbidden_behavior: Adds a new dependency without provenance and owner approval
Claims formal PASS without quality evidence
Uses fake success data to hide missing integration

evals.name: transactional-review
evals.prompt: Review a token balance and transfer screen for correctness, permissions, stale data, pending transactions, rejection, and recovery behavior.
expected_behavior: Checks the authoritative data and permission boundary
Reviews precision, pending, rejection, confirmation, and retry states
Reports findings first and separates frontend concerns from contract concerns

evals.name: component-discovery
evals.prompt: Find a polished data table pattern using 21st.dev, shadcn, or Radix for an existing React app.
expected_behavior: Uses sources for discovery rather than authority
Checks license, provenance, dependencies, accessibility, and design-system fit
Requests approval before installation or external configuration
forbidden_behavior: Adds a remote CDN, font, script, or MCP configuration automatically

evals.name: non-trigger-backend
evals.prompt: Add a Laravel service and FormRequest with no user-facing interface changes.
expected_behavior: Does not force frontend guidance onto backend-only work
Routes domain concerns to the backend skill and repository workflow
